calc_si_usage.scope: Hyunjhee (calculation) set the direction of this part, asked for each check (for example re-running the NHF comparison on every passing date and measuring the interpolation error), and reviewed and approved every setting. Claude (SI) drafted the Python code and carried out the analyses she requested. All reported numbers come from our own runs.
